Interface PopupAware

All Known Implementing Classes:
AlertPopupController, CardsPopupController, ConfirmationPopupController, CountdownPopupController, DecisionPopupController, DiceThrowPopupController, FinalScoresPopupController, PlanetsPopupController, SettingsController, ShipPopupController, ShipPreviewPopupController, TileSelectionPopupController
public interface PopupAware
Interface to be implemented by controllers of popup views.

Enables lifecycle management and communication between the Popup class and the controller associated with the FXML file used in the popup.

When a popup is shown, it automatically invokes the appropriate methods on a PopupAware controller if implemented.

  • Method Details

    • bindPopup

      void bindPopup(Popup popup)
      Binds the controller to the corresponding Popup instance. This allows the controller to interact with the popup, for example to close it programmatically.
      Parameters:
      popup - the popup instance this controller is managing

    • setPopupVisible

      void setPopupVisible(boolean visible)
      Called when the popup is shown or hidden. Useful for updating internal visibility flags or pausing background logic.
      Parameters:
      visible - true if the popup is currently visible, false otherwise

    • isPopupVisible

      boolean isPopupVisible()
      Returns whether this popup is currently visible.
      Returns:
      true if the popup is visible, false otherwise

    • initialize

      void initialize(Object... args)
      Initializes the popup controller with optional arguments. These arguments are provided during the popup construction process.
      Parameters:
      args - the optional arguments passed from the Popup factory method

    • onClose

      void onClose()
      Called when the popup is being closed. Use this method to perform cleanup, animation finalization, or to persist state.
